description: spec §3.4, §3.6, §3.7, §3.9: the scopes' guarded OVSDB writes on the recorded pod rows (with the case's changes): the AP scope's M2 intents (with the case's profile, multi_bss and passphrases by reference), the telemetry scope's statistics publishing, the probe watch's rows, and a steering window that replaces the station's watch row. Per case: the plan's refusal (a Reason), or the submission's status and every transaction sent. The server replies to every insert with the UUID 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000ff. Every scope is bound to pod_id.
